operators.name: custom_upsample_bilinear

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: supports strides; may be non-contiguous, kernel handles strides

returns.shape: scale_factor multiplied spatial dims, same batch/channels

semantics: Corresponds to reference: x = self.upsample(x) where upsample is nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2.0, mode='bilinear')
Output spatial dims = floor(input_spatial * scale_factor), same as PyTorch upsample bilinear
Supports only bilinear mode as used; scale_factor scalar applies to last two dims
Preserves memory layout: output contiguous with row-major strides like reference output
Handles arbitrary input strides by respecting actual strides in kernel; no assumption of contiguity
Numerical semantics match torch.nn.functional.interpolate with align_corners=False (default)

operators.name: custom_softmax_dim

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: arbitrary shape with at least dim+1
parameters.layout: supports strides; input is contiguous in reference but kernel must respect strides

semantics: Corresponds to reference: x = torch.softmax(x, dim=self.softmax_dim)
Softmax normalization over given dim, preserving all other axes
Stable computation: subtract max along dim before exp to avoid overflow
Output shape identical to input; returns contiguous tensor matching input shape and dtype
Input strides may be non-contiguous; kernel must handle arbitrary strides
Upsample input with scale_factor=2.0 and mode='bilinear'
Output spatial dims doubled: [64,3,1024,1024] for given input
Bilinear interpolation with align_corners=False (PyTorch default)
Output dtype float32, device cuda:0, contiguous stride [3145728,1048576,1024,1]
Softmax over dim=1 (channels) for each spatial location and batch
Output shape identical to upsample output, dtype float32, same strides
Stable softmax with per-location max subtraction
Return final softmax result tensor
Shape [64,3,1024,1024], dtype torch.float32, device cuda:0
